ValidationRule.description: Credit Line remaining balance can not be negative. Validate Drawn Amount field again remaining balance in credit line.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula:
OR (AND( (CLA_Credit_Line__r.CLA_Remaining_Amount__c - CLA_Drawn_Amount__c ) < 0 , ISNEW() ) ,
AND(NOT(ISNEW()) , CLA_Credit_Line__r.CLA_Remaining_Amount__c - ( CLA_Drawn_Amount__c - PRIORVALUE(CLA_Drawn_Amount__c) ) < 0 ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Credit Line remaining balance can not be negative.
